name: Age of Imperialism, 1 January 1895
description: The Age of Imperialism world map: its terrain, rivers, resources, roads, and railways exactly as the scenario paints them, on a 90 x 180 upright map that stands the Civ3 grid on its corners. The thirty-one powers of 1895 hold their cities. Turns are days.
intro: 1 January 1895. The great powers have carried their empires across the globe and are dividing what is left. Japan is the default command; any nation can be played with --nation.
